item.title: Chop & Change delivers Christmas dinner service at The Deep
item.description: Chop & Change celebrated the festive season on 10 December 2025 with a special Christmas dinner service at The Deep in Hull, delivering a full three-course lunch prepared and served by young people with severe learning difficulties, supported by hospitality professionals and volunteers. item.title: Donation from A Mischief of Rats marks official closure for Hull’s public art team
item.description: The creators of Hull’s beloved public art trails have officially brought their remarkable run of community projects to a close – presenting a donation of £160,000 to the Daisy Appeal, raised through the A Mischief of Rats sculpture trail that captured hearts across Hull and the East Riding earlier this year. item.title: Healthy Holidays Hull returns with free activities for children & young people
item.description: Healthy Holidays Hull is back for Christmas, bringing the usual exciting range of completely free activities for school aged children and young people living in Hull. There is something to suit everyone, including dedicated SEND sessions, throughout the winter break. The fun on offer includes, swimming, sports, arts, dance, musical theatre and so much more. […]

item.title: Christmas card competition winners announced for 2025
item.description: Hull City Council is excited to reveal the winners of its 2025 Christmas Card Competition, celebrating the creativity of young people across the city. item.title: Drypool Bridge: Council announces details on next phase of works
item.description: Hull City Council has announced the details for the next phase of works on Drypool Bridge. The bridge will be fully closed to all vehicles and pedestrians for eight weeks from mid-late May 2026, as part of the major repair and strengthening programme.
